big_case.notes: Published Tenth Circuit decision addressing whether Turner v. Safley deference or VMI intermediate scrutiny applies to sex-segregated jail housing, commissary, and strip-search policies affecting a transgender detainee, which drew a 23-State amicus brief and a CVSG. However, intervening decisions in United States v. Skrmetti and West Virginia v. B.P.J. substantially narrowed its prospective constitutional stakes, and the Court resolved the petition via a routine summary GVR order rather than plenary merits review.
